question: Could cleanup of an eventually completed failed preparation remove faces owned by a later preparation?
finding: The installed browser loader creates fresh FontFace objects, captures its own loaded array, and its dispose method deletes only those exact objects from document.fonts. It does not delete a global family-keyed registry. The candidate failure cleanup retains its own fonts promise. No cross-instance disposal blocker found.
limits: Source inspection only; not general font fidelity or a browser acceptance result.
